scope: Restricted three-point PDP on y^2+xy=x^3+1; distinct nonzero factor abscissas different from target x
purpose: Test norm versus chained S3 beyond the original panel and inspect coefficient-search cost as the factor-base subspace grows
reference: Complete independent group-law enumeration on identical targets and factor bases
correctness_target: Zero missing or extra solutions in completed instances; every admitted certificate verifies
boundary: Encoding changes cannot change the supported-target set at fixed base and arity. Full-DLP S and rho ratios unmeasured.
metrics: Completion, exact solution sets, circuit evaluation counts, separate field primitive categories, diagnostic timings. No SAT search operation counter is available.
inference: Timeout means incomplete, not UNSAT or a mathematical rejection; no speedup/exponent claim from diagnostic wall times
artifact_policy: Append each finished case to raw.jsonl; retain exceptions and incomplete cases; write summary to new file
